title: Release notes — Cursor Cost Tracker (1.0.3)
intro: Optimize and Support tabs, From date, budget day basis, Pro percent status bar, Over Warn at filter, and marketplace copy.

sections.name: New features
items: **Optimize tab** — Quick / Balanced (default) / Deep for the last red query (≥ Warn at). Run pastes into the last Agent chat; projected save from local `.ai/optimize-savings.md` (`0 / 0.00 $` until the file exists).
**Support tab** — Buy Me a Coffee (`https://buymeacoffee.com/lzzzielinsn`). GitHub Sponsors omitted until the account is live.
**Budget day basis** — working days (default) or all calendar days (`cursorCost.budgetDayBasis`).
**From date** — load from a local calendar day through today (`cursorCost.historyFromDate`).

sections.name: Improvements / Fixes
items: **Pro status bar** — Current `% / 100%`; Today `% / pace ($)` turns red when at or over daily pace.
**Queries toolbar** — **Over Warn at** pill; Show last / From date under Settings.
**Charts / forecast** — Y-axis follows data; hover uses that day’s calculated budget with green / red amounts.
**Marketplace** — three product goals, Optimize screenshot, Buy Me a Coffee.
